serving.notes: chat_template.jinja is 4116 characters, contains an enable_thinking branch, and contains no default sentence beginning 'You are Qwen'. tokenizer_config.json as returned by the models API has no chat_template key. max_new_tokens 128 is only in the card's quick start. generation_config.json sets do_sample true, temperature 0.6, top_p 0.95, top_k 20, and no repetition_penalty. config.json sets max_position_embeddings to 40960. The repository has four safetensors shards and no adapter_config.json. trainer_state.json sets num_train_epochs to 1 and stops at global_step 5713, epoch 0.24999179529815888. The learning_rate field is the peak logged value, at step 575. train_batch_size is 1. all_results.json reports train_loss 544.6820493646827. Logged reward names are format_reward, mcq_accuracy_reward, and tag_count_reward. The Weights & Biases run page was not retrieved. Featherless and an AIBase page add a medical-exam purpose the card does not state and expand GRPO incorrectly; those pages are not used for the purpose, audience, or function fields. Featherless also says the context length is 32768, which is not the value in config.json.
